title: ffreis flag registry
description: One declarative registry of every deliberate point of variation in a project. The dev toolbar, the runtime feature-flag resolver, and the compile-time build config are all GENERATED projections of this file — never hand-edited per feature. A port (mock<->real swap) is just kind:adapter; feature flags are the whole registry. Canonical source of truth. Reference implementation: heavy-heater/flags/flags.json. Spec: .claude/workspace/AGENTS.md § 'Every point of variation is a declared flag'.

name.description: Stable snake_case identifier. Storage suffix: dev.route.<category>.<name>.

kind.description: adapter=swap implementation (mock<->real, testability); service=route among downstreams; value=typed config; gate=enable/disable a feature.

category.description: Toolbar grouping. data/api/model/content/lang are the 5 canonical dials; feature=pure gates; infra=deploy-time wiring.

binding.description: compile=baked into the build (toolbar shows read-only); runtime=flippable live.

effect.description: route=pick among >=2 options; toggle=on/off. gate flags are always toggle.

options.description: Ordered least-real -> most-real for route flags (e.g. [mock, seeded, live]). Omit for toggle/value.

value_type.description: For kind:value — the type of the tunable. Omit for adapter/service/gate.

default.description: Cost/safety-guarded default. Model flags MUST default to the mock/cheapest option unless justified.

seam.description: The ONE code location where this flag is read. Invariant: one flag -> one seam. Absent only for pure build-input compile flags.

scope.description: env=per-environment default; session=dev localStorage/toolbar; user=per-user rollout; global=remote kill-switch.

cost_guard.description: True if flipping away from default can incur real cost (bill Bedrock, hit prod SES). Forces default=cheapest + a toolbar confirmation.
